name: Zig
description: Zig toolchain from ziglang.org: the newest stable release in the official download index, checked against its sha256 and unpacked with its lib directory.
install: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; curl -fsSL https://ziglang.org/download/index.json -o "$d/index.json"; v=$(jq -r 'keys_unsorted[] | select(. != "master")' "$d/index.json" | sort -V | tail -n 1); case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) a=x86_64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=aarch64 ;; *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; k="$a-linux"; url=$(jq -r --arg v "$v" --arg k "$k" '.[$v][$k].tarball' "$d/index.json"); sum=$(jq -r --arg v "$v" --arg k "$k" '.[$v][$k].shasum' "$d/index.json"); curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$d/zig.tar.xz"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$sum" "$d/zig.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf {{prefix}}/zig.new; mkdir -p {{prefix}}/zig.new {{prefix}}/bin; tar -xJf "$d/zig.tar.xz" -C {{prefix}}/zig.new --strip-components=1; rm -rf {{prefix}}/zig; mv {{prefix}}/zig.new {{prefix}}/zig; ln -sfn ../zig/zig {{prefix}}/bin/zig
upgrade: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; curl -fsSL https://ziglang.org/download/index.json -o "$d/index.json"; v=$(jq -r 'keys_unsorted[] | select(. != "master")' "$d/index.json" | sort -V | tail -n 1); case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) a=x86_64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=aarch64 ;; *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; k="$a-linux"; url=$(jq -r --arg v "$v" --arg k "$k" '.[$v][$k].tarball' "$d/index.json"); sum=$(jq -r --arg v "$v" --arg k "$k" '.[$v][$k].shasum' "$d/index.json"); curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$d/zig.tar.xz"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$sum" "$d/zig.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf {{prefix}}/zig.new; mkdir -p {{prefix}}/zig.new {{prefix}}/bin; tar -xJf "$d/zig.tar.xz" -C {{prefix}}/zig.new --strip-components=1; rm -rf {{prefix}}/zig; mv {{prefix}}/zig.new {{prefix}}/zig; ln -sfn ../zig/zig {{prefix}}/bin/zig
